_comment: Mutations for the Sentinel agent data plane, scored by the read and write differentials restricted to /api/sentinel cases. See mutate.py. The first twelve were confirmed caught in an earlier, unrecorded run.

mutations.name: scoped key sees every org's queue
pending runs come back newest-first
last_used_at is never stamped
mutations.old: if let Err(err) = sqlx::query("UPDATE sentinel_agent_keys SET last_used_at = $1 WHERE id = $2")
mutations.new: if let Err(err) = sqlx::query("UPDATE sentinel_agent_keys SET last_used_at = last_used_at WHERE $1::timestamp IS NOT NULL AND id = $2")

mutations.name: a revoked key still authenticates
a scoped key may touch any org's run
claimed is always true
a terminal run may be downgraded to error
a terminal run is never re-completed
severity survives a non-incident outcome
started_at is overwritten rather than backfilled
a foreign incident_id is accepted
mutations.old: sqlx::query_as("SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE id = $1 AND org_id = $2")
mutations.new: sqlx::query_as("SELECT id FROM incidents WHERE id = $1 AND $2 = $2")

mutations.name: the 400 message uses double quotes
the trace keeps more than fifty entries
trace fields are not capped
mutations.old:
let tool = cap_str(map.get("tool"), 200);
        let result = cap_str(map.get("result"), 1000);
mutations.new:
let tool = cap_str(map.get("tool"), 100000);
        let result = cap_str(map.get("result"), 100000);

mutations.name: trace is serialised with serde separators
a negative count is stored as-is
a fractional float is accepted as an int
a whole float is rejected
mutations.old: Some(f) if f.fract() == 0.0 => Ok(f as i64),
mutations.new: Some(f) if f.is_nan() => Ok(f as i64),

mutations.name: null is treated as a string that fails to parse
a decimal string is rejected
mutations.new: let (int_part, frac_part) = if cleaned.is_empty() { cleaned.split_once('.')? } else { return None };

mutations.name: an explicit null is a missing field again
a list index is dropped from the summary
